“The spatial layers within my inner world are almost at thirty-nine thousand layers, so does that mean I’m effectively at the Ninth Rank Myriad Layer Realm? And within the Myriad Layer Realm, I’m not considered weak?”

A smile formed on Lin Yuan’s face.

Those who had just advanced to the Ninth Rank as Evolvers could often only create single-digit spatial layers, not even reaching the Ten Heavy Realm.

“No wonder they say that those invincible beings at the Eighth Rank quickly cultivate after stepping into the Ninth Rank, the Cosmic Force greatly promotes the expansion of spatial layers.”

Lin Yuan had realized dozens of ordinary Cosmic Forces, more than ten higher Cosmic Forces, and one Source-level Cosmic Force.

...

Merely at the initial step into the Ninth Rank, he had opened up nearly forty thousand spatial layers.

This alone placed him eons ahead of those Evolvers who had newly advanced to the Ninth Rank.

“The key point is, the promotion effect of the Cosmic Force on the expansion of spatial layers is not one-off, but continuous…”

After sensing again for a while, Lin Yuan concluded.

Which means, Lin Yuan would continue to expand spatial layers much more easily than other Ninth Rank Evolvers.

“As for the second aspect of Ninth Rank level cultivation, it’s about comprehending the Rule of Time.”

“But this is not very significant, at least not until advancing to the Myriad Heavy Realm, there’s no noticeable difference.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even if Ninth Rank Evolvers could perceive the Rule of Time, it was done with difficulty, hardly reaching the introductory level.

“That’s about it.”

“It’s time to go back.”

The moment Lin Yuan finished perceiving his changes, his figure vanished, returning to the Milky Way Main Star.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

It was already in chaos.

Even the Central Star Domain far in the Central Star Region detected an A-layer energy fluctuation happening in the Milky Way Star Region.

As the core of the Milky Way Star Region, the Milky Way Main Star naturally detected it too.

Compared with the Observation Bureau of the Central Star Domain, the many Evolvers on the Milky Way Main Star felt it more concretely, more intricately.

And with greater dread.

In the face of such an immense energy fluctuation, even powerful Eighth Rank Evolvers were as fragile as dust.

“What the hell is going on?”

“How can there be such a powerful energy fluctuation?”

Redskin and Greeneye, two Eighth Rank Alien Race beings with furrowed brows, had experience managing Chikun Main Star; for years, they had been managing the Milky Way Main Star diligently for Lin Yuan.

Now discovering such an event within the Milky Way Star Region, they immediately took it seriously.

“It’s unclear.”

“But the energy fluctuation erupted in a desolate area of the star domain, so there are no losses for the time being.”

Chun Bo and Jia Li shook their heads, feeling an alarming unease.

They had posited several possibilities, including an alien invasion.

If it really was an invasion, given the magnitude of that energy fluctuation, it had to be at least a Ninth Rank Alien Race, no, at least dozens of Ninth Rank Alien Races coming together to accomplish this.

My god.

Dozens of Ninth Rank Alien Races?

Many of the Eighth Rank Evolvers present had never seen so many Ninth Rank powerhouses in their lifetimes.

“Has this been reported to the Star Lord?”

Chun Bo collected himself and immediately asked.

No matter if it was an alien invasion or not, they should report this matter to Lin Yuan first, as he was the pillar of the Milky Way Main Star, even of the entire Milky Way Star Region.

“We’ve made contact.”

“The Star Lord hasn’t replied to me.”

Redskin said hesitantly.

“No reply?”

Jia Li was slightly startled and then spoke urgently, “Contact him again.”

Just then.

A figure appeared in the hall.

“There’s no need to worry.”

Lin Yuan glanced at everyone and spoke in a gentle tone.

His breakthrough to the Ninth Rank had put him in a good mood, and his demeanor softened a great deal.

“Star Lord.”

“The Star Lord, you’re here.”

The anxiety in all the Evolvers present quickly settled down.

“Star Lord.”

Mo Li and Wu Lan also looked at Lin Yuan with excitement.

They had been on the Milky Way Main Star for some time but had never seen Lin Yuan.

“Star Lord, you said there’s no need to worry…” Shortly after, Chun Bo tentatively asked.

Upon hearing this.

Everyone else immediately perked up their ears.

“`

The energy fluctuation was simply too great, and since it appeared in the Milky Way Star Region, how could one not worry?

“The energy fluctuation was caused by my breakthrough to the Ninth Rank. It only affected the desolate area and will not have any impact on Life Planets or resource planets,”

Lin Yuan said indifferently.

The Star Domain where the breakthrough occurred was carefully selected by Lin Yuan precisely to minimize the impact of his own breakthrough.

“So it was the Star Lord’s doing…”

Chun Bo nodded his head and then sensed something was off. His voice trembled as he said, “Star Lord, did you just say something? Breakthrough to the Ninth Rank?”

The others were similarly stunned, looking at Lin Yuan with shock.

Breakthrough to the Ninth Rank?

“Yes.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

His breakthrough to the Ninth Rank would soon be made public by human civilization as a deterrence against the Starry Sky Races. There was no need for secrecy.

As for why not keep it hidden as a trump card?

Human civilization did indeed secretly cultivate Evolvers, but these Evolvers were unknown to others from the First Rank onward.

For Lin Yuan, the strongest genius of this generation in human civilization, there was absolutely no need to hide.

Human civilization was not some weak clan that needed to keep a low profile. As one of the most powerful Peak Clans in the cosmic starry sky, other clans were too busy fearing them.

The more monstrous and diabolical the geniuses of human civilization were, the greater the deterrence against other clans.

“Star Lord, you’ve advanced to the Ninth Rank?”

The two Eighth Rank Alien Race members with blue eyes and red skin were dazed.

There was a time when they, as the Chikun Star Lord’s subordinates, were given to Lin Yuan as capable followers for entering the Star Domain.

From the prosperous Chikun Star Domain to the barren Milky Way Star Region, from the unbeatable Chikun Star Lord at the Eighth Layer to the newly advanced River Star Lord at the Eighth Rank.

Although blue eyes and red skin, the two Eighth Rank Alien Race members, did not dare to have other thoughts, the sense of loss in their hearts still existed.

But now?

Lin Yuan had stepped into Ninth Rank?

Did he completely surpass their former master, the Chikun Star Lord?

“Star Lord…”

Mo Li’s mind was a mess.

Initially, as a Red Patternn Examiner, after being chosen by the Peak Master of the Thirteen Peaks,

Mo Li was overjoyed, because according to his family’s analysis, the Peak Master of the Thirteen Peaks among the Red Kun Lineage held enormous potential.

By joining the Thirteen Peaks, it was as though he had clung to a great thigh, a mighty backer for the future.

But now what?

Hasn’t the future come too quickly?

And isn’t this thigh a bit too thick?

Ninth Rank.

How long has it been?

He’s become a Ninth Rank already?

Mo Li swallowed hard, suddenly feeling apprehensive.

Could he truly grasp this surprise that fell from the sky?

“Congratulations Star Lord on advancing to the Ninth Rank.”

Wu Lan was the first to react, primarily because she didn’t fully understand the significance and impact of Lin Yuan advancing to the Ninth Rank.

Ignorance is bliss indeed has some truth to it.

“Congratulations Star Lord on advancing to the Ninth Rank.”

Upon hearing this, the others also promptly recovered and congratulated him in unison.

“Rise, all of you.”

Lin Yuan waved his hand, casually speaking.

“Star Lord.” Jia Li cautiously said, “I heard that Ninth Rank Evolvers can merge with the Great Universe. Is that true?”

One doesn’t need to eat pork to have seen pigs run.

In the virtual world of human civilization, there are many videos about Ninth Rank Evolvers.

“Merge with the Great Universe?”

Lin Yuan smiled slightly, “It’s merely a method of integrating into the deeper Spatial Layers.”

Ninth Rank Evolvers derive multiple Spatial Layers within their Inner Worlds, thereby exploring deeper and farther into the Spatial Layers of the Main Universe.

Utilizing the Spatial Layers of their Inner World to resonate with the Spatial Layers of the Main Universe, they then merge into it. This is the external perception of Ninth Rank Evolvers merging with the Great Universe.

As for such Ninth Rank Evolvers in this state… unless their presence in a specific Spatial Layer is locked on, any external attacks can be ignored.

Be it physical attacks,

Soul attacks,

Or even more mysterious attacks.

They are not in the same Spatial Layer; they cannot even be touched, let alone attacked.

This technique of merging with the Great Universe is also a common method used by Ninth Rank Evolvers.

If the interactions and combat between Evolvers below the Eighth Rank simply compare the strength of their attacks,

Then, during combat between Ninth Rank Evolvers and stronger, the competition is whether you can find the Spatial Layer the opponent is in.
